title: The Forge now shares its loadout
summary: Equipment, the Skill Hall, and mutations use one active build. Relics add inspectable instruction text; they do not train a model.
details: Three reachable sockets support drag, select-and-place, removal, undo, and saved configuration revisions. Existing four-item builds remain inspectable.

title: An encounter with inspectable evidence
summary: The recovered 2D stage now presents deterministic player practice and captured local model results with replay controls.
details: Animation receives the checker result. No damage, invented responses, or global rankings are computed by the presentation. Device-local inference is optional and requires consent.

title: Four investigations on Ledger Island
summary: Investigate decimals, mint identity, account ownership limits, and documentation provenance in short deterministic missions.
details: Examples are retained from the exact cited Solana documentation commit. No wallet or current chain observation is involved.
